description: This source file represents the code-behind for the TakenCourses page in an online examination system. It handles page load events and button click events to navigate to other pages such as Dashboard, UserProfile, Leaderboard, and LoginPage.

classes.name: TakenCourses
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TakenCourses page that manages navigation between different pages upon button clicks.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for the page load event. Currently does not perform any actions.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the 'home' button is clicked; transfers control to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the 'profile' button is clicked; transfers control to the UserProfile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the 'leaderboard' button is clicked; transfers control to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the 'logout' button is clicked; transfers control to the LoginPage.
